mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.seller_id AS selleridValue, m.nickname AS sellerNickname, p.name, p.description, p.price, s.quantity AS stockQuantity, p.status, p.category, pi.product_image_id AS imageId, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, pi.is_thumbnail AS thumbnail FROM products p JOIN members m ON m.member_id = p.seller_id JOIN stocks s ON s.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productIdValue} ORDER BY pi.is_thumbnail DESC, pi.product_image_id;
